create_rank_to_trace_dict_from_dir: create a rank to trace filename map from all trace files in a directory
create_rank_to_trace_dict: create a rank to trace file mapping by parsing rank metadata from a list of trace files
get_trace_files: get a dictionary mapping rank IDs to trace file paths from a trace directory
read_trace: read trace data from a .gz or .json trace file and return it as a dictionary
write_trace: write trace data as a dictionary to a .gz or .json trace file on disk
update_trace_rank: update or add the distributedInfo rank metadata field in an existing trace file
